summary: Frontend-only regression executed on public preview URL at mobile 390x844. Login, Home sections (ETA/search/promos/category grid/rails), Shop category switching, Search input flow, Account modules, bottom-tab usability, and Cart->Checkout navigation were tested. A critical integration issue remains on Shop product-card ADD/floating-cart/cart state; product add from direct product page works.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping product ADD on /categories did not transition card to quantity stepper and floating cart bar did not appear; cart remained empty from this flow.
One product image URL returns 404 in console.

integration_issues.flow: Shop -> ProductCard ADD -> Floating cart -> Cart
integration_issues.issue: State update from ProductCard ADD appears broken in Shop route; same user session can add to cart from direct product page and checkout successfully.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: deprecated shadow* props and props.pointerEvents usage.

action_items: Fix Shop ProductCard ADD integration so quantity stepper + floating cart appear and cart updates from categories flow.
Re-verify product detail controls/back flow with stable selectors (pd-back/product-detail-name visibility was inconsistent in web automation despite route opening).
Replace/remove broken external image URL(s) causing 404.
(Optional) Address RN-web deprecation warnings for shadow and pointerEvents usage.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx uses LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true), which can hide real runtime issues during QA.
src/api/client.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL; confirm env contract alignment with platform guidelines to avoid config drift.
ProductCard has correct testIDs, but observed runtime behavior suggests event/state propagation issue specific to categories interaction path.

success_rate.frontend: ~75% critical flows passed; 1 critical integration flow failed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials verified from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: test@gharana.in / Test@1234. Product detail route opens via open-product-* click (URL changes to /product/<slug>). Direct product add-to-cart and /cart -> checkout works. Failure is specific to Shop ProductCard ADD -> cart state/floating bar path.
rca_of_issue: Reproduced three times: On /categories, clicking add-* succeeds visually as click action but no resulting stepper/floating cart/cart item. In same session, adding from /product/chakki-whole-wheat-atta works and checkout navigation passes (/checkout?delivery=express&promo=). Likely route-specific UI state update/integration issue in ProductCard usage inside categories list/virtualization path.
